description: Resolve a Greek buyer or supplier NAME to its ΑΦΜ. For when you have a name but no ΑΦΜ: get_entity, entity_counterparties and the buyer_afm/supplier_afm filters take the 9-digit number. Matching is accent- and case-insensitive; returns the closest names with their ΑΦΜ.

kind.description: Restrict to public bodies (buyer) or companies (supplier). Omit for all.

name.description: Full or partial name, e.g. "Δήμος Αθηναίων". Accents and case are ignored.

name: find_entity

afm.description: pass this to get_entity / buyer_afm / supplier_afm

title: Find Entity by Name
